# Addio al Celibato Barcellona

> Italian agency specializing in bachelor parties (addio al celibato) and bachelorette parties (addio al nubilato) in Barcelona since 2017. No intermediaries, free quotes.

## About

Founded in 2017 by Italians living in Barcelona. We organize exclusively in Barcelona — no multi-destination packages — giving us unrivalled local knowledge. Over 1,200 events organized. 98% client satisfaction.

## Services — Bachelor Party (Addio al Celibato)

Night activities:
- Cena Strip Disco — dinner + male strip show + nightclub
- Cena + Spogliarellista — dinner with female strip show
- Spicy Mix — limousine + strip show + nightclub (best seller)
- Limousine + Discoteca
- Party Boat + Discoteca

Daytime activities:
- Paddle Surf
- Catamarano / Party Boat (day)
- Escape Room
- Cocktail Lab
- Beer Bike
- Quad tour

## Services — Bachelorette Party (Addio al Nubilato)

- Cena Strip Disco — dinner + male strip show + nightclub
- All Inclusive Silver / Gold — limousine + strip show + nightclub
- Catamaran + Strip Show
